lines.text: Friend of me? Friend of mine!
Many learners say: He is a friend of me.
Better: He is a friend of mine.
Mine! He is a friend of mine.

data.wrong: He is a friend of me.
data.right: He is a friend of mine.

native.tip: En inglés se dice “a friend of mine”, igual que “un amigo mío”, no “of me.”
